verdict.rationale: Basecamp's pricing page offers "CLI access and skills for AI agents," and its official API repo points AI agents to a first-party Basecamp CLI (github.com/basecamp/basecamp-cli), so an official CLI aimed at AI-native use exists. The evidence only confirms that it exists; it says nothing about what the CLI can do. missing for 10: CLI command/feature documentation, installation and authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: CLI access and skills for AI agents you run on your computer.
